fields.name: global_checksum
fields.description: Global-region checksum byte (custom algorithm outside Schema v2 list: accumulator starts at 1, then acc += 1 + byte[i] mod 256 for i in 1..271; stored 0xDA verifies against baseline). Recomputed by FUN_080397e0 and rewritten by FUN_08038e28.
fields.evidence: FUN_080397e0 sums global-region bytes 1..271 (acc=1; acc+=1+b[i]); FUN_08038c50(local_11c,0,0x110) loads the 272-byte global region from EEPROM blocks 0..33. Recomputation over rev8-logical bytes 1..271 yields 0xDA, equal to stored byte 0.

fields.name: global_time_records
fields.description: 90 packed 3-byte time-record entries shared by 3 record groups (group g entry k at file offset 2+3*g+9*k; all 270 bytes nonzero in baseline). Encoded by FUN_08038e28, decoded by FUN_08039900 into 8-byte entries at career RAM DAT_08038e24 (+0x0/+0xf0/+0x1e0 per group); defaults seeded by FUN_08038f00.
fields.evidence: FUN_08038e28 writes 3 groups x 30 entries x 3 bytes at save+2 with interleaved stride (base save+2+3*g, step 9); FUN_08038d80 decodes the same layout via FUN_08039900 (mixed-radix digit split including /600, /60, /10 time digits) into DAT_08038e24; FUN_08038f00 seeds RAM defaults with first entry byte = group+3.

fields.name: slot0_checksum
fields.description: Slot 0 checksum byte (custom algorithm: accumulator starts at 2, then acc += 1 + byte[i] mod 256 for i in 1..79; stored 0x97 verifies against baseline). Recomputed by FUN_08039834 over the 80-byte slot.
fields.evidence: FUN_08039834 sums slot bytes 1..79 (acc=2; acc+=1+b[i]); FUN_08038c10/FUN_08038c50 move the 80-byte slot between EEPROM blocks 34+idx*10..43+idx*10 and RAM. Recomputation over rev8-logical bytes yields 0x97, equal to stored byte 0 of every slot.

fields.name: slot0_profile_name
fields.description: Slot 0 profile/driver name, 8 characters (all zero = empty in baseline).
fields.evidence: FUN_08039048 copies save bytes 1..8 to career RAM +0x300..0x307 and stores NUL at +0x308; FUN_080393a0 copies career RAM back to save bytes 1..8; FUN_080399b8 follows the same 8-chars-plus-NUL convention.

fields.name: slot0_option_flags_a
fields.description: Slot 0 packed option flags A (bit0 = career+0x3d4, bit1 = +0x3d5, bit2/bit4/bit5/bit6/bit7 = DAT_08039674 option group, bit3 always 0). Applied to the live race in FUN_0802d580, then persisted by FUN_080393a0. Baseline 0xE3.
fields.evidence: FUN_080393a0 packs career +0x3d4/+0x3d5/DAT_08039674-group into save byte 9; FUN_08039048 unpacks bit0->+0x3d4, bit1->+0x3d5, bits2..7->option group; FUN_0802d580 copies these career bytes into the live race struct and calls FUN_080393a0.

fields.name: slot0_option_flags_b
fields.description: Slot 0 packed option flags B: four 2-bit option selectors from the career +0x396/+0x397/+0x398/+0x399 group, applied to the live race in FUN_0802d580. Baseline 0x45.
fields.evidence: FUN_080393a0 packs the career option group into save byte 10; FUN_08039048 unpacks bits0-1->career+0x396, bits2-3->+0x397 group, bits4-5->+0x398, bits6-7->+0x399 group; FUN_0802d580 applies +0x396..+0x399 to the race struct.

fields.name: slot0_option_flags_c
fields.description: Slot 0 packed option flags C: bit0 = career+0x394, bits1-3 = career+0x395. Copied into the live race config by FUN_0802d580. Baseline 0x00.
fields.evidence: FUN_080393a0 packs b(+0x394) | b(+0x395)<<1 into save byte 11; FUN_08039048 unpacks bit0->career+0x394, bits1-3->+0x395; FUN_0802d580 copies +0x394/+0x395 into the race struct before calling FUN_080393a0.

fields.name: slot0_entry_progress
fields.description: Slot 0 per-entry progress states: 136 2-bit entries (values 0..3) mirroring career RAM +0x30c[136]. The first entry selects display/behavior tables in FUN_08029a40 (also used as a zero-vs-nonzero gate); defaults seeded from a table by FUN_0801fa34. Baseline all zero.
fields.evidence: FUN_08039048 expands save bytes 0x0C..0x2D (4 packed 2-bit values per byte) into career +0x30c[136] and FUN_080393a0 packs them back; FUN_08029a40 consumes (career+0x2a4)*3+(career+0x30c) as a display-table index with a ==0 gate; FUN_0801fa34 seeds +0x30c from a ROM table.

fields.name: slot0_flags_d
fields.description: Slot 0 packed flags D: 8 one-bit career values from the +0x39c/+0x39e/+0x3a0 family and the DAT_08039680/DAT_08039684 group. Baseline 0x00.

fields.name: slot0_flags_e
fields.description: Slot 0 packed flags E: 8 one-bit career values from the +0x3a4/+0x3a6/+0x3a8/+0x3ac family and the DAT_08039688/DAT_0803968c/DAT_08039684 group. Baseline 0x00.
fields.evidence: FUN_080393a0 packs the +0x3a4/+0x3a6/+0x3a8/+0x3ac family and DAT_08039688/DAT_0803968c/DAT_08039684-group bits into save byte 0x30; FUN_08039048 unpacks them back to the same career bytes.

fields.name: slot0_flags_f
fields.description: Slot 0 packed flags F: low nibble from career +0x3ac and the DAT_08039684/DAT_0803968c group (high nibble always 0). Baseline 0x00.
fields.evidence: FUN_080393a0 packs b(DAT_08039684+0x10)<<1 | b(DAT_0803968c) | b(+0x3ac)<<2 | b(DAT_08039684+0x12)<<3 into save byte 0x31; FUN_08039048 unpacks the same destinations.

fields.name: slot0_value_g
fields.description: Slot 0 single-byte value combining career+0x3af (low bits) with the DAT_08039684+0x13 group (high bits). Baseline 0x00.
fields.evidence: FUN_080393a0 packs b(+0x3af) | b(DAT_08039684+0x13)<<3 into save byte 0x32; FUN_08039048 unpacks to career +0x3af and the DAT_08039684+0x13 group; FUN_0802d580 copies +0x3af into the live race struct.

fields.name: slot0_best_records
fields.description: Slot 0 best-record values: eight 24-bit little-endian values (e.g. best times/scores), zero-extended into career RAM +0x3b4 (8 uints) on load. Baseline all zero.
fields.evidence: FUN_08039048 copies save bytes 0x33..0x4A as eight 3-byte units into career +0x3b4 (8 uints) and FUN_080393a0 packs them back; FUN_0802aaa0/FUN_0802d580 consume career+0x3b4 for results display and race setup; FUN_0801fa34 seeds +0x3b4 from a ROM table.

fields.name: slot0_extra_h
fields.description: Slot 0 state byte from career+0x3b0 (fresh-save default 0x1E per FUN_08039690; checked by result/flag logic). Baseline 0x1E.
fields.evidence: FUN_080393a0 copies career+0x3b0 to save byte 0x4B and FUN_08039048 loads it back; FUN_08039690 defaults career+0x3b0 to 0x1E; FUN_0802aaa0 and related logic branch on career+0x3b0.

fields.name: slot0_extra_i
fields.evidence: FUN_080393a0 packs b(+0x3b1)<<3 | b(+0x3b2) into save byte 0x4C; FUN_08039048 unpacks to career +0x3b1/+0x3b2.

fields.name: slot0_extra_j
fields.description: Slot 0 state byte from career+0x3b3. Baseline 0x00.
fields.evidence: FUN_080393a0 copies career+0x3b3 to save byte 0x4D and FUN_08039048 loads it back.
